messages:
tara: Support escalated acct helios-3 trial activation stuck on 'provisioning'. Customer has onboarding demo in 6 hours, renewal touchpoint in 26 days.

josh (support): Error shows region quota hit for eu-central-1 and token refresh 502 intermittently. SUP-9132 opened.

anya: Quick mitigation options: 1) temporary routing to us-west-2, 2) increase soft quota for trial in eu-central, 3) schedule a 15-min enablement call during demo. Recommend (1) to keep demo on time.

infra-bot: Created OVERRIDE-420, awaiting infra approval (ETA ~30m).

josh: Customer asked for ETA. They're nervous about the demo.

anya: I'll craft a short comms: acknowledge, say we're enabling temporary route, offer 15-min overlap during demo to monitor, promise RCA within 48h. Also propose a one-week POC extension if activation isn't fully restored by renewal checkpoint.

tara: Please proceed with routing if infra approves. Tagging this as renewal-risk-watch. I'll join the enablement call.

infra-bot: OVERRIDE-420 approved. Routing flip in 3m.

josh: Provisioning completed after routing flip. Demo confirmed. I'll file a short tech note and link to SUP-9132.

tara: Thanks team. Actions: anya send comms + POC extension proposal, josh update ticket, infra schedule postmortem. Closing escalation for now.
